sentences.en: Good morning everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: I'm Steve Wainwright from Elmley Town Council and I organise the town's volunteer scheme.
sentences.zh: 我是埃尔姆利镇议会的史蒂夫·韦恩莱特，负责组织本镇的志愿者计划。

sentences.en: I'm delighted you're all interested in joining the scheme.
sentences.zh: 很高兴看到各位对加入该计划感兴趣。

sentences.en: Our volunteers help to create a sense of community among the man: y people who live in our historic town of Elmley and make residents and visitors feel welcome at local events.
sentences.zh: 我们的志愿者帮助在历史悠久的埃尔姆利镇众多居民中营造社区感，并让当地活动中的居民和游客感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: First, I'll mention just a few of the activities that volunteers carry out.
sentences.zh: 首先，我仅简要介绍志愿者开展的一些活动。

sentences.en: One is to walk around the town centre streets wearing our volunteer T -shirt.
sentences.zh: 其中一项是穿着我们的志愿者T恤，在镇中心街道上巡视。

sentences.en: Tourists often ask how to get to a particular shop, and they might also be grateful for recommendations about what to visit.
sentences.zh: 游客经常询问如何前往某家特定商店，他们也可能很感激您推荐值得参观的景点。

sentences.en: The town holds a large number of concerts each year and part of the volunteers' role is to get everyone in the audience to the right place as smoothly as possible.
sentences.zh: 本镇每年举办大量音乐会，志愿者的部分职责就是确保所有观众尽可能顺畅地抵达各自座位。

sentences.en: You'd be surprised how man: y people buy tickets, then don't check them, and head for the wrong section of the hall.
sentences.zh: 您会惊讶于许多人买了票后却不核对票面信息，结果走错了音乐厅的区域。

sentences.en: Volunteers may get involved with community groups, such as sports clubs or gardeners' associations.
sentences.zh: 志愿者还可参与各类社区团体，例如体育俱乐部或园艺协会。

sentences.en: Here, the volunteers talk about how groups can help each other.
sentences.zh: 在此，志愿者们探讨各团体如何相互支持。

sentences.en: For instance, a writing group might want to travel to another town to hear a talk by a well - known author, but may not know that another club has a coach they could travel in.
sentences.zh: 例如，一个写作小组可能希望前往另一座城镇聆听一位知名作家的讲座，却不知另一家俱乐部恰好拥有一辆可供使用的长途客车。

sentences.en: The town produces a monthly magazine, and anyone who lives in the town can send in articles.
sentences.zh: 本镇每月出版一份杂志，凡居住在本镇者均可投稿。

sentences.en: It's free to residents and is paid for by local businesses.
sentences.zh: 该杂志向居民免费发放，经费由本地企业赞助。

sentences.en: That's the responsibility of the council's advertising department we depend on volunteers though to find out what people think of events they've attended and any suggestions they have for the future the volunteers then send a summary to the editors there are a number of clubs for retired people and every year the council arranges lunch for all the members the volunteers welcome the guests and when everyone's sitting down and relaxing after the meal, some volunteers put on a show.
sentences.zh: 这属于议会广告部门的职责；不过，我们依赖志愿者去了解人们对其所参加活动的看法，以及对未来活动的建议；随后，志愿者将汇总意见提交给编辑。本镇设有多个面向退休人士的俱乐部，议会每年为所有会员安排一次午餐；志愿者负责迎接宾客，待所有人落座用餐并放松休息后，部分志愿者还会进行表演。

sentences.en: Usually around half an hour of songs and short plays, the club members really welcome the chance to chat to the volunteers at these events.
sentences.zh: 通常是一场约半小时的歌曲与短剧演出；俱乐部成员非常欢迎借此机会与志愿者交流。

sentences.en: OK, now you know some of the things our volunteers do, I'll go on to some practical matters.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在大家已了解我们志愿者的部分工作内容，接下来我将介绍一些实际事项。

sentences.en: As you probably know, the town arranges three major festivals every year, and they all depend on a large number of volunteers.
sentences.zh: 各位可能知道，本镇每年举办三大重要节日，而这些活动均需大量志愿者支持。

sentences.en: The book festival lasts three days, and uses several venues which all need volunteers.
sentences.zh: 图书节为期三天，使用多个场地，每个场地都需要志愿者。

sentences.en: More are needed for the music festival because that lasts a whole week, and even more help is required for the science festival, even though it's only two days long.
sentences.zh: 音乐节持续整整一周，所需志愿者人数更多；尽管科学节仅有两天，但所需协助人数甚至更多。

sentences.en: It involves quite a lot of venues, though.
sentences.zh: 尽管它涉及相当多的场地。

sentences.en: It's a good idea to help at the festival you're most interested in, because you can attend most of the events for free.
sentences.zh: 帮助你最感兴趣的节日是个好主意，因为你可以免费参加大部分活动。

sentences.en: We try to use volunteers who are flexible, though, because some festival events are held outdoors and the weather may affect the size of the audience and even whether the event can take place so there can be changes at short notice What essential though is being able to get on well with other people and also to deal with someone who's behaving badly, as occasionally happens.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们尽量使用灵活的志愿者，因为一些节日活动在户外举行，天气可能会影响观众人数，甚至影响活动能否如期举行，因此可能会有临时变动。但最重要的是，要能与他人融洽相处，还要能妥善处理行为不当的人，这种情况偶尔会发生。

sentences.en: Our plan is to get you all working in September, after a week's training starting on the 2nd, so we'll be timetabling you for duties the following week from the 9th onward.
sentences.zh: 我们的计划是在经过从9月2日开始为期一周的培训后，于9月份安排大家正式上岗，因此从9月9日起将为您排班安排工作。

sentences.en: Later in the week beginning September 23rd we have a chat with each of you to find out how you feel about being a volunteer and what extra support you need.
sentences.zh: 在9月23日当周的晚些时候，我们会与每位志愿者进行一次交流，了解您对志愿工作的感受以及您需要哪些额外支持。

sentences.en: As a thank you to the volunteers we arrange an annual event.
sentences.zh: 作为对志愿者的感谢，我们会每年组织一次特别活动。

sentences.en: In recent years we've had a party in the Town Hall and last year a barbecue in Chamber Park.
sentences.zh: 近年来，我们曾在市政厅举办过派对，去年则在钱伯斯公园举行了烧烤活动。

sentences.en: Our forthcoming event is a trip along the canal from here to Dewhurst and back.
sentences.zh: 我们即将举办的活动是一次乘船沿运河从这里前往德赫斯特再返回的行程。

sentences.en: It's on Saturday, September the 28th.
sentences.zh: 活动时间为9月28日（星期六）。

sentences.en: And if you'd like to attend, you can sign up once you start work.
sentences.zh: 如果您希望参加，可以在开始工作后报名。

sentences.en: Now, this is the Volunteer's T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是志愿者T恤。
